story_p1: Since 2022, millions of Ukrainians have found themselves in a new country within weeks, without the language, while air-raid alerts, blackouts and shelters became part of everyday life. We saw how much simple knowledge matters: what to tell a doctor, how to stop bleeding, what to pack in a go-bag.
story_p2: Orizo Labs turns this experience into learning apps — for Ukrainians and for everyone who wants to be prepared. Our goal: everyone should have the knowledge that makes a new reality less frightening.
exp1_p: Alerts, blackouts, evacuation, life after moving abroad — we teach what millions of Ukrainians have already lived through.
exp2_p: Orizo Labs' founders and experts include veterans with many years of experience, some of it at international level. We review preparedness courses as a team: veterans and hands-on instructors analyse the content together, so the advice works in real life.
exp3_p: Our founder has built and grown his own business in Ukraine, including in wartime. That is why we spend resources carefully, test ideas fast and get products into people's hands.
orgs_intro: Our products work for groups too: we give access to teams, students and communities and help you see the results.

org2_p: Civil preparedness courses for classes, volunteers and residents, with exams and certificates.
org3_p: Access packages for NGOs and public programmes that support people who have moved.
org4_p: Training for veterans and a new role for them: becoming an Orizo instructor or course author.
partners_p: We are looking for employers, schools, NGOs, veterans' organisations and integration programmes to bring access to the people who need it most. We are open to conversations with investors.

q1: Do I need to sign up?
a1: No. No account is needed; your progress is stored on your iPhone.
q2: How do I move my progress to another phone?
a2: Settings → “Backup” → “Save”: you can keep the file in Files or iCloud Drive. On the new phone, choose “Restore”.
q3: How do I cancel a subscription?
a3: iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions → 2000 Phrases. Access lasts until the end of the paid period.
q4: Will there be an Android version?
a4: Yes, we are working on it. For now the app is available for iPhone.
q5: Found a mistake in a phrase?
a5: Write to us at support@orizolabs.com or use “Write to the developer” at the bottom of the home screen — the email will already include the app version and language.

experts_intro: We don't invent safety rules: we gather what has already worked in Ukraine and have it checked by people who know it from practice.
ex1_p: Orizo Labs' founders and experts include veterans with many years of experience, some of it at international level. Together they analyse the lessons on threats, shelters and behaviour in a crisis, so the advice works in real life, not just on paper.
ex2_p: First aid, navigation and field skills are reviewed by instructors who teach people in person.
ex3_p: We rely on public civil-protection guidance and update lessons as threats change.
w1_p: Calmly prepare your home, children and loved ones — without panic and without overspending.
w2_p: Ready-made lessons and exams for classes, explained in plain language.
w3_p: Joint preparation for residents, group training and an instructor log.
w4_p: Ukraine's experience for people in Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, Poland, Slovakia and other countries where preparedness has become part of life.
ta_note: Civilian and protective only: how to recognise a threat and protect yourself and others. No combat tactics, weapons or instructions that could cause harm.

ts_desc: Support for the 2000 Phrases app: how to contact us, move your progress and manage your subscription.
ts_lead: A question, a mistake in a phrase or an idea for 2000 Phrases? Write to us — we reply in Ukrainian or English.
ts_p: Support email: support@orizolabs.com. The fastest way is “Write to the developer” at the bottom of the app's home screen: the email will already include the version, language and level.
ts_plus: You can cancel or change your subscription in iPhone Settings: your name → Subscriptions → 2000 Phrases. If you reinstalled the app or changed phones, tap “Restore purchases” on the Plus screen.
ts_priv: The app needs no account and collects no personal data. Details are in our privacy policy.
val_quote: Experience is the greatest value in life. We gather it and pass it on professionally.
val1_p: We teach only what life has tested: Ukraine's reality, military service, working abroad. Experience that came at a high price should protect others.
val2_p: Being a professional means answering for every word in a lesson. Our content is checked by people who have done it in practice, not just read about it.
val3_p: Knowledge that saves lives is free. We respect people's time, money and privacy, and we speak to them honestly.

inv_lead: Orizo Labs builds learning apps on Ukraine's experience for two large audiences: Ukrainians living abroad, and Europeans for whom civil preparedness has become part of life.
m1_t: Ukrainians hold temporary protection in the EU — a record as of August 2026. They need the language every day: at the doctor's, at work, with paperwork.
m2_t: of emergency supplies is what the European Commission advises every household to keep. Preparedness is becoming public policy across Europe.
m3_t: Ukraine has lived with air-raid alerts, blackouts and evacuations. We turn this hands-on experience into courses for everyone.

why_intro: The world has become unstable. The Baltic states, Poland and other countries live next to a real threat on their borders and are already preparing their citizens for a crisis: schools, communities, every family. Ukraine went down this road first, and its experience is needed right now.
why_value: Safety and peace of mind are the greatest values of our time. We give people the knowledge that keeps them safe.
team_intro: Orizo Labs is an alliance of specialists, not just developers. Every product is made by people who know their craft from practice, including at international level.
r1_p: They turn experience into clear lessons: course structure, quizzes, scenarios, exams and certificates.
r2_p: They teach people in person and make sure every piece of advice works in a real situation.
r3_p: Years of service and work at a high international level are the foundation of our preparedness courses and the Service Academy.
r4_p: Entrepreneurs and developers who bring knowledge to people's phones: fast, offline and in many languages.
